title: Protesters jeer as Starmer arrives in Golders Green
originalTitle: Protesters jeer as Starmer arrives in Golders Green
content:
Sir Keir Starmer has been jeered by protesters as he visited Golders Green following an attack on two Jewish men on Wednesday.

Protesters shouted "Keir Starmer, Jew harmer" as a convoy entered the offices of a volunteer Jewish medical charity where the prime minister met with emergency services who responded to the attack.

Police are treating the attack on 34-year-old Shloime Rand and 76-year-old Moshe Shine as a terrorist incident. The suspect is a 45-year-old British national who came to the UK as a child from Somalia.
